name: nexa-eval
description: NEXA-M2-008 retrieval and grounding evaluation set. 'corpus' items run against the PNG STEM curriculum corpus (M2-002) with real models; 'fixture' items run against the synthetic corpus below with deterministic stand-ins, in CI, and cover behaviour the corpus cannot: authority conflicts, school vs national scope, access, citation integrity and failure behaviour. A corpus hit is a retrieved chunk from one of the expected files that contains every evidence phrase. Items with approved=false (draft Tok Pisin translations) are reported but do not gate a release until a Tok Pisin speaker approves them.
corpus_ref: NEXA-M2-002 corpus, 72 approved sources, built by v1/tools/knowledge_corpus.py

fixture_corpus.text: Helicase unwinds the DNA double helix by breaking the hydrogen bonds between base pairs during the S phase of the cell cycle.

Our school garden activity: sweet potato leaves use photosynthesis to turn sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into sugar.

Photosynthesis in chloroplasts converts light energy, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.
Answer key for the photosynthesis quiz: question 1 is chloroplast, question 2 is glucose.
Encyclopedia article: photosynthesis is how plants convert sunlight into chemical energy stored in sugar.
A covalent bond forms when two atoms share a pair of electrons between them.
Inductive charging transfers energy through a changing magnetic field, so a phone charges without plugging it into a power socket.
